color_space: RGB; no embedded ICC profile; treated as sRGB without profile conversion
visible_ink_detection: max(R,G,B) < 150 within expected Normal Home wordmark region

background_sample_policy.interpolation: linear by source y between sample band centers 119.5 and 193.5

alpha_matte.method: least-squares projection between local estimated background and opaque ink anchor; stable unmatting for semi-transparent edge pixels
alpha_matte.non_unique_alpha_note: The frozen page is pre-composited. The matte is an explicit deterministic approximation, not recovered original alpha or vector source.
